currentRoundInspection.scope: Three actually inspected western/southern exterior photographs and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke plans or redistributed reference images.

pictures.author: Rupen Janbazian
pictures.observed: Actually inspected close western oblique: warm tan ashlar, central faceted cylindrical drum and ribbed stone cone with cross, intersecting gabled arms, narrow round-headed lights and arched eyebrows, broad horizontal narrative relief frieze and selected medallion/panel masses. A much lower shallow-roofed western narthex fills foreground. Lower approach and bell porch are cropped. Fine sculpted scenes and inscriptions are simplified rather than copied into textures.

pictures.author: Mcdrwal
pictures.observed: Actually inspected southern oblique: shallow stone cross roofs, warm ashlar, conical drum with narrow windows and scalloped cornices, polygonal corner projections, prominent relief friezes/medallions and lower western extension with tiny slit lights. South entrance has two stacked stone arch stages and a small open columned pavilion/cone; pale/dark alternate stones mark portal arches and bell roof. Foreground vegetation hides some base. Fine carved iconography is represented only by sparse low relief abstractions.

pictures.author: Ozlmktv
pictures.observed: Actually inspected straight southern entrance and current approach: dark recessed lower door through a round checker-stone arch, open upper front arch and side passage, gabled cornice and small columned bell pavilion/pointed stone cap. Central drum/cone behind, broad relief band, paired wall recesses/slit windows and uneven stone entrance steps. Low narthex at west/left. Vegetation hides eastern base. No measured dimensions or interior completeness inferred.
